trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Distinct high-frequency serrations are visible along the trailing edge of the left lobe, characterized by 10-14 low-amplitude peaks before the boundary is obscured by water; right lobe trailing edge presents a more uniform, lower-frequency serration profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe displays a pronounced convex fold transitioning to a steep concave curve at the trailing edge; the right lobe exhibits a largely linear sweep with a slight convex distal termination.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast, high-intensity circular clusters (barnacles) are detected along the peripheral leading edges of both lobes; a prominent group of approx. 6 individuals is located on the leftmost distal edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of sessile barnacles (likely Coronula genus) attached to the outer margins of both the left and right fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Structural anomaly consisting of a severe inward curl or fold of the left fluke lobe, partially occluding the dorsal/ventral intersection.
